subject: Passoff: CarePath - Final owner assignments & acceptance criteria
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, care-success@redwood.com
Cc: Elaine Wu <elaine.wu@carepath.com>, Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@carepath.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Passoff: CarePath - Final owner assignments & acceptance criteria

Hi team —

Thanks for the quick close last week. Per our conversation, CarePath has committed to a pilot (10k monthly tokens) with a target production pilot start of 2028-04-23. Key commercials are attached (SOW_CarePath_v3.docx); legal is cc'd via contracts@carepath.com for the signature path.

High-level summary: 
- Primary contact: Elaine Wu (Dir, Data & Integrations) — elaine.wu@carepath.com
- Secondary contact: Rajiv Menon (IT Ops) — rajiv.menon@carepath.com
- Contract value: $54,000 ARR (pilot pricing applied)
- Desired go-live for pilot: 2028-04-23, 2-week acceptance window thereafter
- Acceptance criteria (requested by CarePath): 95th percentile latency < 500ms for 1k token flows; no more than 1 failed request per 10k over 14 days; embedding similarity baseline to be measured against sample set (attached prompt/queries).

Technical/context notes: 
- They'll deploy a single integration using our hosted API; later they may opt for Dedicated pools.
- They require IP allowlisting and proof of SOC2 controls (snapshot attached).
- Main dataset is non-PII patient summaries; legal flagged audit log retention for 90 days.

Immediate asks for CS: 
1) Confirm owner for kickoff and weekly ops syncs.
2) Validate the acceptance criteria above and flag any concerns.
3) Request an initial kickoff window next week (Mar 22–24) for 60 minutes to align SOW milestones and runbook.

Attachments: [SOW_CarePath_v3.docx] [CarePath_SOC2_snapshot_2027.pdf] [network_allowlist_template.csv]

Thanks — I'll stay on to support the first 2 weeks of onboarding.

— Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
(415) 555-0198
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, care-success@redwood.com
Cc: Elaine Wu <elaine.wu@carepath.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Mar 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Passoff: CarePath - Final owner assignments & acceptance criteria

Vanessa — thanks for the thorough summary and the attachments. A couple quick clarifications before we schedule the kickoff: 

1) Latency SLO: the 95th < 500ms target is achievable for the 1k token baseline with our standard hosted routing, but we'll need to instrument tracing at kickoff to validate. If they need < 200ms we should discuss Dedicated.
2) Audit logs: 90-day retention is fine but will need a retention policy signed off in the kickoff playbook.
3) IP allowlist: Rajiv, we'll need the CIDR ranges and a secondary public key for client TLS. Rajiv, can you share the allowlist values?

Owner assignments (proposed):
- Onboarding lead: Tessa Morgan (CS) — primary day-to-day for pilot implementation and runbook
- Technical escalation: Ben Carter (CS Lead) — architecture and performance tuning
- Sales liaison: Vanessa Ortiz — contract & commercial questions through acceptance

Tessa, if this looks good please propose two kickoff slots next Wed/Thu (Mar 22/23).

Action items for contracts: Vanessa, can you confirm who at CarePath will sign the SOW and whether DocuSign is preferred? Elaine, tagging you for visibility.

— Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
From: Elaine Wu <elaine.wu@carepath.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@carepath.com>, contracts@carepath.com
Date: Tue, 20 Mar 2028 09:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Passoff: CarePath - Final owner assignments & acceptance criteria

Thanks Vanessa and Ben — confirmed. 

We can do DocuSign for the SOW (contracts@carepath.com will handle), and Rajiv will send the IP ranges by EOD today. Two quick clarifications from our side before kickoff: 
- For acceptance, the similarity baseline will be measured against a 200-sample evaluation set; we'll upload that to the Miro board this afternoon.
- We also need a short runbook item that shows how Redwood handles model fallback for degraded latency (preferably in the first-week onboarding checklist).

Available times for kickoff (PST):
- Wed Mar 22: 10:00–11:00 or 15:00–16:00
- Thu Mar 23: 09:00–10:00

Looking forward to the kickoff.

— Elaine
Elaine Wu
Director, Data & Integrations, CarePath Health
elaine.wu@carepath.com
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, care-success@redwood.com
Cc: Elaine Wu <elaine.wu@carepath.com>, Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@carepath.com>, contracts@carepath.com
Date: Wed, 21 Mar 2028 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Passoff: CarePath - Final owner assignments & acceptance criteria — kickoff scheduled + next steps

All — thanks, good momentum. Quick summary and owners so we have a single source of truth prior to kickoff: 

Kickoff: Thu, Mar 23, 2028 09:00–10:00 PST (calendar invite sent).
Owners: 
- Onboarding lead / Runbook & acceptance owner: Tessa Morgan (tessa.morgan@redwood.com) — deliver kickoff agenda, runbook skeleton, and acceptance playbook by Wed 03/22 EOD.
- Technical escalation / perf tuning: Ben Carter (ben.carter@redwood.com) — run pre-kickoff perf checklist and confirm tracing hooks with CarePath during kickoff.
- Sales liaison & contract questions: Vanessa Ortiz (vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com) — confirm DocuSign path with contracts@carepath.com and track signatures.
- Customer contacts: Elaine Wu (product contact) and Rajiv Menon (network/ops).

Action items (owner — due):
- Rajiv: Send IP allowlist (CIDR) and public key — due EOD Tue 03/20 [pending; Elaine said EOD Tue].
- Tessa: Draft kickoff agenda, runbook skeleton, and acceptance checklist (include fallback behavior documentation) — due Wed 03/22 EOD.
- Ben: Confirm tracing/troubleshooting hooks and expected 95p baseline under test load — due Wed 03/22 EOD.
- Vanessa: Initiate DocuSign and confirm signer contact — due Wed 03/22 EOD.

Attachments referenced for kickoff prep: SOW_CarePath_v3.docx; CarePath_SOC2_snapshot_2027.pdf; network_allowlist_template.csv.

I'll post the runbook draft to the Miro board and share a link in the kickoff invite. If anyone needs to reassign items, please flag today.

Thanks — Tessa
Tessa Morgan
